messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT: HIGH - kubelet not ready on multiple nodes in cluster 'prod-usw2' (auto-page). Affected: gpu-node-231, gpu-node-232, gpu-node-233. Incident: PD-4987. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4987

ashley_oncall: acked via PD. I'm taking first responder. Pulling logs + connecting to serial for gpu-node-231.

maya_support: seeing a small spike in 503/429 from the embeddings tier, a few user requests retried. Not full outage but error rate up ~2.8%.

nik_sre: quick check: kubelet reports NotReady on 231/232/233. System shows repeated kernel oops on 231. Could be NIC firmware / driver bad.

ashley_oncall: running quick node check:
```
$ kubectl get nodes --selector=pool=gpu -o wide | egrep "NotReady|gpu-node-23"
gpu-node-231   NotReady   3h   10.0.23.231   us-west-2a
gpu-node-232   NotReady   1m   10.0.23.232   us-west-2a
gpu-node-233   NotReady   30s  10.0.23.233   us-west-2a
```

ashley_oncall: grabbing dmesg / journal for 231 now.

nik_sre: paste from serial (recent):
```
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 1234.567891] CPU: 5 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/5 Not tainted 5.10.0-rc1 #1
[ 1234.567895] RIP: 0010:netdev_rx in_panic+0x1a/0x40
[ 1234.567900] ---[ end trace 9a8bf1b3c2 ]---
```

ashley_oncall: uuugh kernel panic on 231. 232/233 seem to have kubelet flaps (likely same rack/hardware).

james_infra: I see correlated NIC errors from our telemetry for rack r29 (to which those nodes belong). Could be a TOR switch firmware or NIC. I'll escalate to the hardware ops team and open a provider ticket. Acking PD.

ashley_oncall: immediate mitigation: cordon gpu-node-231/232/233 to stop scheduling, drain 231 first (best-effort, evict pods with disruption budget consideration). Starting now.

ashley_oncall: commands I'm running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-231
kubectl drain gpu-node-231 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
```

maya_support: notifying affected customers who have long-running queued jobs; will send a short note: "degraded inference performance in us-west-2" if this persists.

ashley_oncall: drain results: one training job evicted (team-ml), two inference replicas rescheduled to other racks. No data loss expected. Failover succeeded for most traffic.

incidentbot: auto-escalation: multi-node kernel panic + customer impact flagged -> escalated to eng-infra and oncall-manager.

james_infra: provider case opened (CASE-2026) with cloud vendor; will attempt live NIC repro and request TOR team to check rack port statuses.

nik_sre: temporary mitigation suggestion: enable node-level fallback routing in the router config for upstreams in us-west-2 to send additional capacity to other racks (reduce tail latency). Can trigger a config rollback if errors rise.

ashley_oncall: doing a quick router ramp: bump fallback weight on us-west-2 routes. Observed tail latency for embeddings down from +2.8% to +0.6% after failover.

maya_support: customers notified: two customers informed (queued job owners). No broader user-facing status page update yet; waiting for infra confirmation.

ashley_oncall: short checklist for follow-up:
- RMA gpu-node-231 (hw panic) - ticket CASE-2026
- Run firmware update/driver rollback on same rack nodes after maintenance window
- Keep rack cordoned until infra confirms TOR/NIC stability
- Postmortem with thread logs + timeline (assign after handoff)

james_infra: ack. I'll coordinate with hardware ops for RMA and book maintenance window 02:00 PST.

ashley_oncall: handing off to day shift SRE at 08:15 UTC (will ping for recap). If anything changes before then I stay on. Leaving cordon/drain state and PD incident notes.

ashley_oncall: summary for handoff -> PD-4987: multi-node NotReady in rack r29 due to kernel panic on gpu-node-231; nodes cordoned and gpu-node-231 drained; minor customer impact limited to a couple evicted jobs and a small tail-latency bump; infra escalation and provider case opened; RMA planned.

pagerduty: Incident PD-4987 acknowledged by ashley_oncall and escalated per policy.

nik_sre: leaving a pending action: collect full /var/crash and AMT logs from 231 before RMA. I'll script a snapshot.

maya_support: I'll follow up on customer comms post-RMA and update support playbook with wording for kernel-panic-related degraded performance.

ashley_oncall: thanks all. moving to monitoring mode. :thumbsup:
